sections.content: You know *para* (A2 Unit 30) and *para que* + subjunctive (B1 Unit 4). *Con el fin de* + infinitive also gives a purpose: use them to explain purposes and objectives.

items.english: We study in order to improve our Spanish.

items.spanish: Salimos temprano todos los días para que no haya problemas.
items.english: We leave early every day so that there are no problems.

items.spanish: Organizaron varias reuniones con el fin de escuchar todas las opiniones.
items.english: They organised several meetings with the aim of listening to every opinion.

sections.content: *Para* + infinitive works when the same person acts and benefits (*estudiamos para mejorar*); when the purpose belongs to someone else you need *para que* + subjunctive: *salimos temprano para que no haya problemas*.
